title: SpaceX ends Starship Flight 15 with a catch
summary: SpaceX&\#x27;s Starship Flight 15 ended with a catch of a returning vehicle, a reusability step toward the company&\#x27;s goal of a fully reusable launch system. The submitted item consists of SpaceX&\#x27;s launch-page link and a livestream link, so it does not provide flight telemetry, the condition of the caught hardware, or a technical explanation of the maneuver. Community discussion treats the catch as progress toward reflight and lower payload costs, but those outcomes are not established by the submitted material.
